            on  variable  biogas  production;  therefore,  the removal
               requires the control of the oxygen supply so that removal
             happens properly and the methane/oxygen relation remains
                 far from the ﬂammable zone for the biogas (typically for con-
               centrations of methane between 5 and 15% in air) described
             by Dupont & Accorsi () and Speece ().
                 In the present study, the stability and robustness of the
              microaerobic removal is observed when intrinsic variations
               to real digesters operation happen. The variation of the
                sulfur load of the sludge, lack or excessive oxygen rate to
              the digester and cleaning of the HS are evaluated.
